purpose: T2 record audit, the download named in docs/dispatch/2026-09-18-t2-record-audit.md (shared with T1 by predicate, requested as its own download because T1's SIMPLE_CSV lacks informationWithheld and genusKey)
why_provisional: Requested under the test account described in the owner's GBIF credentials report (2026-09-18). The business account will redo this exact request; the new DOI is then added as a superseding entry here and this one stays.
predicate_source: docs/pulls/gbif-fungi-north-america-2015-2025.json, unchanged since 4e247d5; the request stored by GBIF (format, checklistKey, predicate) was compared with this file after the run and is equal
submitted_with: request_body() from forager_forecast.records.gbif_download, POSTed with HTTP basic auth from Python's urllib (not curl_argv, which would put the password in a process argument list); credentials from GBIF_USER, GBIF_PWD, GBIF_EMAIL; the notification address is the account's and is not recorded here
local_copy: data/t2/downloads/ on the machine that ran it, gitignored; the DOI is the citation
integrity_check_2026-09-18: GBIF publishes no checksum for a download: the download record has no hash field and the download link's ETag is not a content hash. What was checked: the local zip's byte size equals the record's size field, and `unzip -t` reports no errors in the compressed data (every member's CRC). The sha256 above is this machine's own, for detecting later corruption, not GBIF's.
